Before you drive

Rental Requirements

To protect our clients and our vehicles, every rental is verified personally before handover. Please have the following ready when you book — our team will guide you through each step.

1

Valid Driver’s Licence

A full, valid driver’s licence held by the primary driver, presented at booking and again at handover.

2

Identity Verification

Government-issued photo identification so we can confirm the renter and every authorised driver.

3

Insurance Verification

Proof of insurance, or choose a MOD LUXURY protection plan during booking. Coverage is verified before pickup.

4

Payment Method

A valid payment method in the renter’s name for the deposit, balance and any agreed charges.

5

Rental Agreement

Agreement to our rental terms, including care of the vehicle, authorised drivers and return conditions.

Good to know

Frequently Asked Questions

What documents do I need to rent the BMW 330i?

You will need a valid driver’s licence, government-issued photo identification, proof of insurance (or a MOD LUXURY protection plan selected during booking) and a payment method in the renter’s name. If someone else will also drive, their licence and identification are required as well. Documents are submitted securely during the booking steps and verified by our team before your reservation is confirmed.

How does the deposit work?

A deposit of 30% of your total booking value is due when you reserve, securing the BMW 330i for your dates. The remaining balance is payable at pickup. Your booking review shows the full breakdown — vehicle rental, protection, add-ons and taxes — before you confirm, so the amount due today and the balance at pickup are always clear.

Where do you deliver, and can I pick up myself?

Both. Choose delivery and we will bring the BMW 330i to your address in Downtown Toronto, Yorkville, Etobicoke, North York or Vaughan, or arrange handover at Toronto Pearson Airport (YYZ). Prefer to collect in person? Self pickup in Toronto, ON is available by appointment. Simply select Delivery or Self Pickup above, and confirm the details in the booking steps.

What is included for mileage?

Every rental includes a generous mileage allowance suited to travel in and around Toronto, detailed in your rental agreement. Planning a longer journey? Add Extended Mileage during booking, or speak with our concierge team and we will tailor the allowance to your itinerary.

What protection options are available?

Standard Protection is included with every rental. For complete peace of mind, Full Premium Protection is available at $95 CAD per day. You may also use your own insurance — proof of coverage is uploaded during booking and verified by our team before pickup. Full terms are set out in your rental agreement.

Rental & Cancellation Policy

Clear Terms, Considered Service

Plans change, and we believe cancelling or amending a reservation should be as straightforward as making one. The summary below reflects our standard policy; your rental agreement, provided at booking, is the governing document and prevails in the event of any difference.

CancellationsPlease contact our concierge team as early as possible. Refundability of your deposit depends on how much notice is given before your pickup time, as set out in your rental agreement.
Changes to Your DatesDate and time changes are accommodated wherever availability allows. Rate differences, if any, are confirmed with you before the change is made — never applied without your agreement.
Late Returns & No-ShowsIf you are running late, let us know and we will do our utmost to assist. Extended use beyond your return time, and missed pickups without notice, may incur charges under your rental agreement.
